title.en: What a Drive Is Made Of

desc.zh: 机械硬盘和固态硬盘里装的东西完全不同，电脑却用同一套方式读它们。八个可以拖动的模型：编了号的扇区、寻道和转动、叠瓦磁道、闪存单元里的电压层、纠错码和寿命、闪存翻译层、接口与协议的分层地图、一次读取的时间花在哪。
desc.en: A hard disk and a solid-state drive contain completely different things, yet the computer reads both the same way. Eight models you can push: numbered sectors, seek and rotation, shingled tracks, voltage levels in a flash cell, error correction and lifetime, the flash translation layer, a layered map of connectors and protocols, and where the time of one read goes.

desc.zh: 硬盘对电脑只是一排编了号的格子；4096 字节的物理扇区模拟 512 字节时，没对齐的写入要先读后写。
desc.en: To the computer a drive is a numbered row of blocks; when 4096-byte physical sectors emulate 512-byte ones, misaligned writes become read-modify-write.

zh: 分区为什么要 4K 对齐

title.zh: 机械硬盘：寻道、转动等待与外圈更快
title.en: Hard disks: seek, rotational latency and faster outer tracks

desc.zh: 一次随机读要等磁臂摆过去、等盘片转半圈；寻道短距离按平方根、长距离按直线增长；外圈一圈装得多所以顺序读更快。
desc.en: A random read waits for the arm and for half a turn; seek time grows as a square root for short seeks and linearly for long ones; outer tracks hold more per turn, so sequential reads are faster there.

zh: 机械硬盘随机读写为什么慢
en: how does a hard drive work
why HDD random IOPS is low

title.zh: 叠瓦式记录（SMR）与热辅助记录（HAMR）

desc.zh: 磁道叠起来能多装一些，但改一条要重写后面整组；容量增益很快饱和，改写代价线性增长。
desc.en: Overlapping tracks store more, but changing one means rewriting the rest of its band; the capacity gain saturates while the rewrite cost grows linearly.

en: why are SMR drives slow to write

title.zh: 闪存单元：SLC、MLC、TLC、QLC、PLC 与读裕量
title.en: Flash cells: SLC to PLC and the read margin

desc.zh: 每格存 n 位就要在同一个电压窗口里分 2ⁿ 层；层越多间距越窄，相邻钟形重叠，读错的概率按正态尾巴急升。
desc.en: Storing n bits per cell splits one voltage window into 2ⁿ levels; more levels mean narrower gaps, overlapping bell curves and error rates that climb along a Gaussian tail.

zh: SLC MLC TLC QLC 区别
TLC 和 QLC 哪个耐用
en: SLC vs MLC vs TLC vs QLC
how does flash memory store data

title.zh: 闪存为什么会坏：擦写次数、纠错码、TBW 与 DWPD
title.en: Why flash wears out: P/E cycles, ECC, TBW and DWPD

desc.zh: 每次擦写让电压分布变宽，纠错码能扛住的误码率决定能擦写多少次；寿命 = 擦写次数 ×（1+预留）÷ 每年写入。断电保存随温度按阿伦尼乌斯关系变快流失。
desc.en: Each program/erase cycle widens the voltage spread; the error rate ECC can absorb sets the cycle count; lifetime = cycles × (1 + spare) ÷ yearly writes. Unpowered retention falls with temperature by Arrhenius.

zh: 固态硬盘断电放久了会丢数据吗
en: how long does an SSD last

title.zh: 闪存翻译层（FTL）：不能原地改写与垃圾回收
title.en: The flash translation layer: no in-place updates, garbage collection

desc.zh: 闪存按页写、按块擦，所以固态硬盘把新数据写到别处，再改地址表；空白块不够时搬走有效页、整块擦除。
desc.en: Flash writes pages but erases blocks, so an SSD writes new data elsewhere and updates a map; when free blocks run low it moves valid pages out and erases whole blocks.

zh: 固态硬盘为什么不能覆盖写
en: why SSD cannot overwrite in place

title.zh: 存储接口分层地图：外形、连接器、链路、传输、命令集
title.en: Storage interface map: form factor, connector, link, transport, command set

desc.zh: M.2、U.2、E1.S 是外形和连接器，SATA、SAS、PCIe 是链路，ATA、SCSI、NVMe 是命令集；逐层对得上盘才能用。
desc.en: M.2, U.2 and E1.S are form factors and connectors, SATA, SAS and PCIe are links, ATA, SCSI and NVMe are command sets; a drive works only when every layer matches.

zh: M.2 接口是不是都是 NVMe
M.2 SATA 和 M.2 NVMe 区别
M.2 B 键 M 键
SAS 和 SATA 能混用吗
SAS 盘能插 SATA 口吗

title.zh: 固态硬盘为什么比机械硬盘快：延迟与带宽
title.en: Why SSDs are faster than hard disks: latency and bandwidth

desc.zh: 一次读取 = 延迟 + 大小 ÷ 带宽；小而散的读机械盘慢上百倍，大块连续读只慢几倍；分界线约等于延迟乘带宽。
desc.en: One read = latency + size ÷ bandwidth; for small scattered reads a hard disk is hundreds of times slower, for large sequential ones only a few times; the break-even size is latency × bandwidth.

zh: 固态硬盘为什么比机械硬盘快
机械硬盘和固态硬盘区别
机械硬盘拷大文件也不慢
en: why is an SSD faster than a hard drive
why copying many small files is slow

title.zh: 存储前沿（2026 年 11 月）：HAMR 出货、闪存层数、QLC 与 PLC
title.en: Storage frontier (Nov 2026): HAMR shipping, NAND layers, QLC and PLC

desc.zh: 44 TB 热辅助硬盘批量出货，245 TB 的 QLC 固态盘出货，321 层闪存量产，400 层以上和 PLC 尚待证实或商用。
desc.en: 44 TB HAMR drives shipping in volume, 245 TB QLC SSDs shipping, 321-layer NAND in production; 400+ layers and PLC not yet confirmed or commercial.
